item.title: Hot dog days return to iconic, triangular Temescal building
item.description: Hot dog days return to iconic, triangular Temescal building Winky Dinky Dogs celebrated the grand opening of its second location in the building that formerly housed Original Kasper's Hot Dogs.

item.title: Status of Oakland Coliseum deal will be aired out at joint city-county meeting
item.description: Status of Oakland Coliseum deal will be aired out at joint city-county meeting City Council President Kevin Jenkins said it's "imperative that there be an open and public conversation" about the complicated land deal.

item.title: Holiday travel at Oakland airport saw a big dip
item.description: Holiday travel at Oakland airport saw a big dip Passenger volume in November was down nearly 12%. Holiday travel has been struggling since 2023.

item.title: Oakland reacts to ICE and Border Patrol shootings in Minneapolis
item.description: Oakland reacts to ICE and Border Patrol shootings in Minneapolis East Bay leaders are calling for an end to the Trump administration’s aggressive enforcement operations as local protests continue.

item.description: This week in Oakland: ‘Sinners’ in 70mm at Grand Lake Theater, and the OMCA White Elephant Sale Other events include the Fresh Jamz anniversary happy hour, an Oakland Wiki edit-a-thon, a candle and vision board making event, and Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit at the Fox.

item.title: Racial disparities in officer discipline complicate OPD’s push to end federal oversight
item.description: Racial disparities in officer discipline complicate OPD’s push to end federal oversight A federal judge praised progress toward ‘constitutional policing’ but said the Oakland Police Department has not yet earned full independence from court supervision.

item.description: New South Indian spots bring the heat to Berkeley; Tokyo Central readies for Emeryville grand opening A running list of restaurants that have recently opened in Berkeley, Oakland, Richmond, and beyond.

item.title: ‘ICE-free zones’ are coming to Alameda County
item.description: ‘ICE-free zones’ are coming to Alameda County A brand new rule prevents ICE agents from accessing county property to stage operations, process detainees, or surveil.

item.title: Samuel Merritt University’s 2,000 students arrive in downtown Oakland
item.description: Samuel Merritt University’s 2,000 students arrive in downtown Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee, Rep. Lateefah Simon, and Councilmember Carroll Fife were on hand for the grand opening of the school’s new flagship building.

item.title: Signature gathering begins in Oakland for multi-billion-dollar transit measure
item.description: Signature gathering begins in Oakland for multi-billion-dollar transit measure If advocates gather 186,000 signatures across the Bay Area, a half-cent sales tax proposal will appear on the November ballot. Passage would mean an infusion of cash for BART, AC Transit, and other mass transit agencies.
